info.title: NOX Energy API - Household
info.description:
# Household API Documentation

This documentation shows only the household endpoints: the households of your users, the
NOX-connected devices in them and the optimization settings they share.

**Preview:** these endpoints are documented ahead of their release and currently answer
`501 Not Implemented`.

## Authentication

1. Get your API key from [NOX Energy](mailto:support@nox.energy).
2. Include the API key in your API calls with the header: `x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY`.

Base URL: [https://api.nox.energy](https://api.nox.energy)

get.description:
**Preview: not available yet.** This endpoint is documented ahead of its release and currently
answers `501 Not Implemented`. Its contract may still change before release.

Get the households of your users and the NOX-connected devices in them.

A household is a house and all the devices connected in it, behind its grid connection. It adds no
identity to its devices: the `device_id`s are the same ones the heat pump, pv and battery device
endpoints return.

parameters.name: next_token

schema.description:
The `next_token` is a token used to retrieve the next page of results when there are more results
than can fit in a single page(=API response).

By default, the API will return a `next_token` of the first page if no token was given as a parameter.

If the token is `null` you have reached the end of the results.

This should be used together with the `limit` parameter to paginate through results.



To get all results of your call, you can keep calling the same API call with the previously returned `next_token` until it returns `null`.

Pass the `next_token` back unchanged. A token that was altered or not issued by the API returns `400`.

get.description:
**Preview: not available yet.** This endpoint is documented ahead of its release and currently
answers `501 Not Implemented`. Its contract may still change before release.

Get the latest telemetry of your households, in kW.


 * `house_load_kw` is everything the household consumes except the battery.

 * `grid_power_kw` follows the consumption sign convention used by all power fields of the API:
positive when the household imports from the grid, negative when it exports. It is `null` when the
household has no grid metering (see `grid_metering` in `GET /v1/households`).

get.description:
**Preview: not available yet.** This endpoint is documented ahead of its release and currently
answers `501 Not Implemented`. Its contract may still change before release.

Get the forecasted house load of your households in kWh for a specific timeframe with 15 min
granularity.

The house load is everything the household consumes except the battery, before pv production is
subtracted. Heat pump consumption is included.

The timestamp refers to the 15 minutes after it.

parameters.name: start_time

schema.description:
Start of the requested period. Intervals starting at or after this time are returned.
The time is in UTC in ISO 8601 format.



Time format examples:
- 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
- 2023-10-01T00:00:00
